chunks: Ibn Mahbub narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who left brothers and sisters from a father and mother, along with a grandfather.
He said: The grandfather is like one of the brothers, and the estate is divided among them.
For the male is the like of the share of two females.

key_terms.الْجَدُّ: The grandfather mentioned here as an inheriting relative.
key_terms.الْمَالُ: The estate or inheritance property to be divided.
key_terms.لِلذَّكَرِ مِثْلُ حَظِّ الْأُنْثَيَيْنِ: The inheritance rule that a male receives the share of two females.
key_terms.مِنْ أَبٍ وَ أُمٍّ: From both father and mother, meaning full siblings.

ai.seo_question: How is inheritance divided between full siblings and a grandfather in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on inheritance when the deceased leaves full brothers, full sisters, and a grandfather. The Imam عليه السلام states that the grandfather is counted like one of the brothers, and the estate is divided according to the rule that a male receives the share of two females.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5645 - Ibn Mahbub narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdullah (as) who said:
I asked Imam (as) about a man who passed away and left behind brothers and sisters from both his father and mother, along with a grandfather.
Imam (as) said: "The grandfather is considered as one of the brothers, and the inheritance is divided among them
with the male receiving the share equal to that of two females."
